facts.fact: GovStack's account says that in August 2023 a 10-day deep-dive workshop with over 150 participants was held with Egypt's communications ministry (MCIT), 18 localised e-learning modules were developed, and a 50-trainee training of trainers is planned.
facts.system: GovStack Egypt civil servant digital skills programme

EGY.note: Training described is for civil servants, not the public.
Strategy named in passing; no adoption, text or reporting stated.
Only a healthcare citizen engagement application prototype in development; no service launched or piloted.
